name: Prusa Research a.s. (Prusament)
summary: Czech joint-stock company behind the Original Prusa printer ecosystem. Its filament brand, Prusament, is extruded in-house by wholly-owned subsidiary Prusa Polymers a.s. on roughly 12 production lines near Prague. Vertically integrated: Prusa makes its own filament, printers and build surfaces, and no evidence was found of it white-labelling for other brands.

oem_relationships.notes: Intra-group, not third-party white-labelling: Prusa Polymers is Prusa Research's wholly-owned filament subsidiary and is the actual extruder of Prusament. Recorded for completeness; Prusa Research does not appear in research/verified-oem-relationships.md.
Historical: Plasty Mladec was Prusa's official filament partner from 2014 until in-house Prusament production (2018). Reciprocal of filament-pm.json edge; added in Phase E reciprocity pass.

Prusa Research acquired Printed Solid (Wilmington, Delaware) in 2022 and formally rebranded it Prusa USA, Inc. in July 2026. Reciprocal of the printed-solid.json parent-company edge. The Delaware facility extrudes the Jessie filament line and also produces Prusament and PEI print surfaces for North America.

product_lines.name: Prusament PLA
product_lines.notes: Standard PLA; 40+ colours including blends, galaxy/silk-effect grades and limited editions

product_lines.name: Prusament PETG
product_lines.notes: Standard glycol-modified PET copolyester

product_lines.name: Prusament PETG Recycled (rPETG)
product_lines.notes: Same PETG chemistry, post-consumer/post-industrial recycled feedstock

product_lines.name: Prusament PETG Carbon Fiber

product_lines.name: Prusament PETG Tungsten 75%
product_lines.notes: PETG matrix loaded to ~75% tungsten powder for high-density parts; only the matrix id applies, there is no metal-filled PETG id (pla-metal is PLA-based)

product_lines.name: Prusament PETG Ultraglow
product_lines.notes: PETG + phosphorescent pigment; pla-glow is PLA-based so only the matrix id applies

product_lines.name: Prusament PETG V0
product_lines.notes: PETG + flame-retardant package, UL94 V0; abs-fr has no PETG equivalent

product_lines.name: Prusament PETG Magnetite 40%
product_lines.notes: PETG + 40% magnetite (iron-oxide) filler for weight and finish

product_lines.name: Prusament ASA
product_lines.notes: Standard acrylonitrile styrene acrylate

product_lines.name: Prusament PC Blend
product_lines.notes: PC-based proprietary blend rather than commodity PC: density 1.22 g/cm3, HDT 113 C @0.45 MPa / 93 C @1.8 MPa (commodity PC is ~135-140 C), filament tensile yield 58+/-1 MPa - consistent with an undisclosed PC+copolyester or PC+ABS-type blend

product_lines.name: Prusament PC Blend Carbon Fiber
product_lines.notes: Same PC Blend matrix + chopped carbon fibre; no pc-cf id exists (pc-gf is glass and provisional)

product_lines.name: Prusament PC Blend Space Grade
product_lines.notes: Glitter/metallic-effect specialty grade on the same PC Blend chemistry

product_lines.name: Prusament PA11 Carbon Fiber
product_lines.notes: Bio-based polyamide 11 (castor-oil derived) + carbon fibre: density 1.11 g/cm3 (ISO 1183), HDT 192 C @0.45 MPa / 152 C @1.8 MPa, tensile yield 61+/-3 MPa. Genuinely PA11, not PA6 or PA12, so pa6-cf/pa12-cf/ppa-cf all mis-describe it and no pa11-cf id exists

product_lines.name: Prusament PP Glass Fiber
product_lines.notes: Polypropylene + glass-fibre reinforcement

product_lines.name: Prusament PP Carbon Fiber
product_lines.notes: Polypropylene + carbon fibre; the catalog only has pp-gf, no pp-cf id exists

product_lines.name: Prusament PVB
product_lines.notes: Polyvinyl butyral, IPA-vapour smoothable

product_lines.name: Prusament TPU 95A
product_lines.notes: Shore 95A, the firm end of the mainstream flexible band

product_lines.name: Prusament Woodfill
product_lines.notes: PLA matrix + wood-fibre filler

product_lines.name: Prusament PEI 1010
product_lines.notes: ULTEM 1010-grade polyetherimide

product_lines.name: Prusament Resin
product_lines.notes: Photopolymer resins for MSLA printers, not filament

additional_notes: Markets on tolerance: claimed +/-0.02 mm diameter versus an industry norm of +/-0.05 mm, with per-spool QR codes linking to batch measurement data. Pricing roughly $29.99/kg for standard PLA, $49.99 for 2 kg spools, up to ~$44/kg for limited editions. Sells genuine double-sided PEI powder-coated spring steel sheets (smooth and textured) as build surfaces for Original Prusa printers. US PRODUCTION (updated 2026-09-20): the previously single-sourced report of a Delaware production line is now corroborated - Prusa Research acquired Printed Solid of Wilmington, Delaware in 2022 and rebranded it Prusa USA, Inc. in July 2026. That facility runs the filament extrusion line Printed Solid built in 2019 for its Jessie brand and also produces Prusament and PEI print surfaces for the North American market, so United States has been added to manufacturing_countries. See data/manufacturers/printed-solid.json. No HIPS or PVA found in the current catalog; whether those were ever offered and discontinued was not established.

provenance.conflicts: RESOLVED 2026-09-20: the formerly uncorroborated Delaware (US) production line is confirmed by the Printed Solid acquisition (2022) and its July 2026 rebrand to Prusa USA, Inc.; United States has been added to manufacturing_countries. Remaining open point: how the Prusament volume is split between the Czech lines and the Delaware facility is not published.
